headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. The Los Angeles Dodgers also secured a win, defeating the New York Yankees 8-2 behind Trent Grisham's home run and one RBI. The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Will Vest being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation. Other players on the injured list include PJ Poulin, Richard Lovelady, Ryan Helsley, Stephen Kolek, Justin Sterner, Lourdes Gurriel Jr., and Jeff Criswell.

The Oakland Athletics made a trade, acquiring RHP Aiden Moffett from the Chicago Cubs in exchange for RHP Aaron Civale. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, acquiring RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 5 and walking 1.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Trent Grisham leading the offense. Grisham hit a home run and drove in one run in the game.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers dropped a 1-2 decision to the New York Yankees, failing to secure a win. Tommy Edman led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and one RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory. Willson Contreras led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Vest Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Will Vest has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Aiden Moffett in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs in exchange for RHP Aiden Moffett.
